'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Battle of Sievierodonetsk (2022)|Battle of Sievierodonetsk]]
****The mayor of [[Sieverodonetsk]] announces that [[Russian forces]] have "fully occupied" the city. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-forces-occupy-all-ukraines-sievierodonetsk-mayor-2022-06-25/ (Reuters)]
***[[Eastern Ukraine offensive]]
****[[Russian separatist forces in Donbas|Pro-Russian forces]] say that they have entered the city of [[Lysychansk]], the last major city still held by Ukrainian forces in [[Luhansk Oblast]], and that street-to-street fighting is underway. [https://www.firstpost.com/world/ukraine-reports-attack-from-russias-ally-belarus-fighting-in-lysychansk-10837531.html (First Post)]
***Russia launches dozens of [[cruise missile]]s at targets in multiple Ukrainian cities, including [[Yavoriv]], [[Zhytomyr]], and [[Desna, Chernihiv Oblast|Desna]]. At least 20 missiles were fired from [[Belarus]]ian airspace. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-missiles-hit-ukraines-yavoriv-military-base-regional-governor-2022-06-25/ (Reuters)] [https://news.yahoo.com/russians-launch-20-missiles-against-130700849.html (Yahoo! News)]
*[[2022 Oslo shooting]]
**Two people are killed and 21 others injured during [[mass shooting]]s at three separate sites in central [[Oslo]], [[Norway]], including a [[gay nightclub]]. An [[Iranian-Norwegian]] man is arrested and [[Criminal charge|charged]] with [[murder]], [[attempted murder]], and [[terrorism]]. The motive is suspected to be [[Islamic extremism]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-61933817 (BBC News)] [https://www.nrk.no/norge/skyting-ved-utested-i-oslo-sentrum-1.16016478 (NRK)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**A 16-year-old [[Palestinians|Palestinian]] teenager dies in Israeli custody after being shot yesterday by [[Israeli Defense Forces|soldiers]] in [[Silwad]], [[West Bank]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/6/25/israeli-forces-kill-palestinian-teenager-in-occupied-west-bank-2 (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Anglophone Crisis]]
**[[Akwaya massacre]]
***Twenty-six people are killed in an attack in Akwaya district, [[Southwest Region (Cameroon)|Southwest region]], [[Cameroon]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/separatist-violence-increases-english-speaking-parts-cameroon-hrw-2022-06-27/ (Reuters)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Miss International Queen 2022]]
**Fuschia Anne Ravena of the [[Philippines]] is crowned [[Miss International Queen]], widely regarded as the world's largest [[beauty pageant]] for [[trans women]], in [[Pattaya]], [[Thailand]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/filipina-wins-transgender-pageant-thailand-2022-06-25/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*A magnitude 5.6 [[list of earthquakes in Iran|earthquake]] strikes near [[Kish Island]], [[Iran]], killing one person and injuring 31 others. [https://apnews.com/article/middle-east-iran-tehran-earthquakes-persian-gulf-tensions-6a04921af00dab47edcbea5c9dd64715 (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China]]
***[[Shanghai]] declares "victory" over [[COVID-19]] and [[Beijing]] announces the reopening of primary and secondary schools following a decrease in the number of cases. [https://www.reuters.com/world/china/beijing-says-will-reopen-primary-secondary-schools-covid-cases-recede-2022-06-25/ (Reuters)]
*[[2022 monkeypox outbreak]]
**The [[World Health Organization]] declares that [[monkeypox]] is not yet a [[public health emergency of international concern]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/health/health-news/who-monkeypox-public-health-emergency-rcna34726 (NBC News)]
*[[Japan]] reports a record high temperature for the month of June of {{cvt|40.2|C|F}} in [[Isesaki]], [[Gunma Prefecture]]. [https://english.kyodonews.net/news/2022/06/1f66c3b25178-mercury-climbs-to-401-c-in-japan-national-record-for-june.html (Kyodo News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Member states of the Commonwealth of Nations]]
**[[Togo]] and [[Gabon]] officially become members of the [[Commonwealth of Nations]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20220625-west-african-states-gabon-and-togo-join-commonwealth (France 24)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2022 Ecuadorian protests]]
**The [[National Assembly (Ecuador)|National Assembly]] convenes to debate the possible removal of [[President of Ecuador|president]] [[Guillermo Lasso]] amidst ongoing protests. [https://www.lanacion.com.ar/agencias/congreso-de-ecuador-se-reunira-para-resolver-pedido-de-destitucion-de-lasso-nid25062022/ (''La Nación'')] 
*[[Gun politics in the United States]]
**[[United States|U.S.]] [[President of the United States|President]] [[Joe Biden]] signs the [[Bipartisan Safer Communities Act]] into law. [https://www.cnn.com/2022/06/25/politics/biden-signs-gun-bill/index.html (CNN)]
